popupExpandToggleTip: Stretch inner scrollable panels and iframes open to their complete content, rather than capturing them according to what is currently seen. Frames coming from other sites will request one additional permission on a one-off basis.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and synchronised to your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: Permission has been granted - frames coming from other sites will also be expanded.
optionsExpandPermMissing: When there is no "read all websites" permission, cross-site frames are captured according to what is currently seen. Panels and same-site iframes are always usable.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: Scans the text the page makes public, looking for e-mail addresses, telephone numbers, bank card numbers, social security numbers and API keys, and in the saved picture puts an opaque colour block over the content that was matched. It cannot read text drawn as pixels —— a canvas, a picture, a PDF, a video frame. Detection is carried out on your device; no content at all will ever be sent to any place. Applies to whole-page (document scrolling) screenshots; the colour block cannot be undone, so please check the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF can be played everywhere. WebM has a smaller size and a smoother picture (recorded in real time in your browser).
batchPermissionHint: Opening these pages requires granting a one-off permission the first time.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open these pages was refused.
